Kwame, I couldn't set up the daily digest. Nothing is scheduled, so you won't get one tomorrow at 09:00.

The scheduler rejected my connection because the gateway's credentials aren't configured on the system side. I haven't changed any configuration, and I don't have a way to fix that from here. An admin on the OpenClaw side needs to set up gateway auth, and then I can create the 09:00 Chicago digest.

When it's running, the digest will cover new posts in #coastal-team since the last one. It will leave out finance figures (rates, prices, contract values, invoice and payment terms) and point you to June or Anselm for those. You're a member of #coastal-team, so I can read it for you.
